subject: English
passage: Believing that engaging with deliberately challenging musical compositions can enhance cognitive function and emotional resilience, experimental composers Adrienne Dudley and Tomas Silva created a symphony that prioritizes complexity over accessibility. One movement requires musicians to play in seven different time signatures simultaneously; another features intentionally discordant harmonies that resolve in unexpected ways. The effect is demanding but rewarding: after performing the piece regularly for three years, violinist Sowmya Murthy reported improved focus and stress management.
prompt: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?

choices.A: Although performing challenging compositions such as those created by Dudley and Silva can be enriching, it is unsustainable for most musicians.
choices.B: Creating complex musical pieces like those by Dudley and Silva is the most effective way to develop musicians' cognitive abilities.
choices.C: As a violinist, Murthy has long advocated for the compositions of experimental artists such as Dudley and Silva.
choices.D: Although difficult to perform, the complex symphony by Dudley and Silva may enhance the cognitive and emotional development of musicians.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer because it most accurately states the main idea of the text. According to the text, experimental composers Dudley and Silva have created a symphony that is challenging because of several demanding elements, such as multiple simultaneous time signatures and intentionally discordant harmonies. The text goes on to suggest that there may be benefits to this kind of composition because violinist Murthy performed the piece regularly for three years and reported improvements in focus and stress management. Thus, although the symphony is difficult to perform, it may enhance the cognitive and emotional development of musicians.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. Although the text mentions the potential benefits of performing complex musical compositions, it doesn't suggest that this is the most effective method to develop musicians' cognitive abilities.
